records_captured: Upcoming online tournaments of the regulation in force (and one registered to start within 30 days): start time, name, organiser, platform, registrations and whether registration is open (docs/upgrade-plan-2027q2.md, list #31)

fields.name: tournament_id
fields.description: Limitless' tournament id, from the row's tournament link

fields.name: tournament_format
fields.description: The format label the page was filtered on, the regulation registry's limitless_play_format ("M-C")

fields.name: regulation_code
fields.description: The registry's regulation_code for that format ("m-c")

fields.name: starts_at_utc
fields.description: Scheduled start, ISO-8601 UTC (the row's data-date)

fields.name: platform
fields.description: Where it is played: SWITCH (the game) or SIM (Pokémon Showdown)

fields.name: organizer_id
fields.description: The organiser's Limitless id, from the row's organiser link

fields.name: registrations
fields.description: Players registered when the page was read

fields.name: player_cap
fields.description: The registration cap, when the organiser set one

fields.name: registration_open
fields.description: Whether registration was open when the page was read

fields.name: source_url
fields.description: The tournament's details page on play.limitlesstcg.com

fields.name: dataset_version
fields.description: Dataset version this staging snapshot feeds

known_risks: Read from the upcoming page's HTML (the API lists tournaments only once they start): the data-* attributes and two links are all it relies on, and a page without the table fails the extraction rather than reporting no events
A snapshot is a day old by the time the site shows it: the dashboard drops tournaments that have already started
